sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding pump housing ph-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %.
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 4,000 pcs per year over 24 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We offer a price of €51.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

We appreciate your proposal for a 24-month contract and a volume of 4,000 pieces per year; please provide the binding delivery schedules to confirm this volume. Which volume can you commit to? Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.

Our costs move with SCRAP-E3, WAGES-METAL, GAS-TTF; the figures stay with us. Our colleagues will address your request for a cost breakdown separately.

Alternatively, with valid from 1 December 2026: a price of €51.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

It is always a pleasure to build on our long-standing relationship. We note your revised offer and the proposed shift in the effective date to April 2027. To ensure planning stability for our family foundry, we prefer to maintain the start date of 1 December 2026, and in return, we reduce our price to €49.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 45 days net and a contract term of 24 months.

Beside this option, our current Angebot stands at a price of €50.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027. 

We still require the binding delivery schedules to verify your volume commitment of 4,000 pieces per year. Which volume can you commit to?

Please note that this is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
